lines.zh: 我这么长的牙，走路都得张嘴。
lines.en: Teeth this long. I walk with my mouth open.
I walk along the dry riverbed.
Heavy hind legs. My steps are loud.
I walk with my head cocked.
One tooth is all I have. Enough.
One tail swing and the grass goes flat.
I walk slow. I'm long enough already.

lines.zh: 我的影子有三个人那么长。
lines.en: My shadow is three people long.

lines.zh: 我跨过倒下的树干，很轻松。
lines.en: I step over a fallen trunk. Easy.

lines.zh: 我走路时前爪几乎不着地。
lines.en: My forelimbs barely touch the ground.
I search the dry land for water.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，很沉。
lines.en: I press forward, step by step. Heavy.

lines.zh: 每一步都让地面发出闷响。
lines.en: Each step makes a dull drum.

lines.zh: 我顺着风走，不让味道散了。
lines.en: I walk with the wind. Keep my scent off.

lines.zh: 我的牙露在嘴外，很显眼。
lines.en: My teeth show outside my mouth. Conspicuous.
I thread between the low trees.
I open my mouth and let the wind in.

lines.zh: 我的牙有四十六毫米长。
lines.en: My tooth is forty-six millimetres long.
They only ever found one tooth.
I stand like a pillar.

lines.zh: 我嚼了嚼空气，牙齿碰着牙齿。
lines.en: I chew air. Teeth against teeth.
I look up. Too bright.

lines.zh: 我的皮在阳光下有点发亮。
lines.en: My hide shines a little in sunlight.
Counting the smells in the wind.
A slow tail swing clears the flies.

lines.zh: 我什么都没找到，也没关系。
lines.en: Found nothing. That's fine.
I lower my head and study a dead stalk.
My toes dig into the soil.
Dry season is long. I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 我这样站着，猎物会放松。
lines.en: Standing like this. Prey relaxes.

lines.zh: 你站得比我矮，但比我想的稳。
lines.en: Shorter than me. Steadier than I expected.

lines.zh: 我低头，牙对着你的方向。
lines.en: Head down. Teeth toward you.
No scales on you. Soft.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开了，这是警告。
lines.en: My mouth is open. That's a warning.
I counted your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 你这样站着，我不好下口。
lines.en: Standing like that makes this harder.

lines.zh: 我侧过脸，用单眼估你的高度。
lines.en: I turn my head and gauge your height with one eye.

lines.zh: 你退了，那我就不客气了。
lines.en: You backed off. Then I won't be polite.
There's a rust taste in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你这么小，我一口就够了。
lines.en: This small. One bite.
Half a step back. Teeth still out.
Thick hide holds.
You hit my flank.
I shake my head. Clearer now.
Now I want to eat you more.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我前胸的厚皮。
lines.en: That blow landed on the thick hide of my chest.
I circle back. Heavy steps.

lines.zh: 人们只找到我一颗四十六毫米的牙。
lines.en: Only one forty-six millimeter tooth of mine was found.
Teeth intact. Good.
My tooth root throbs, but it holds.
Meat. Not picky this time.
Throw it. I'll take it on my teeth.
That piece. Stop holding it up.

lines.zh: 我这么大的嘴，一小块不够。
lines.en: A mouth this size needs more than a piece.
Set it down, three steps back.
Blood smell. My teeth itch.
I've lowered my head. Can I reach?

lines.zh: 吃东西的时候，别靠近我。
lines.en: Don't come close while I eat.
This bite, I'll chew slowly.

lines.zh: 那块肉放下，我低头就够。
lines.en: Set that meat down; I can reach it.
You hit my leg.
Half a step back. A pit remains.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的胫骨，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my shin and stagger back two steps.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到我的侧面。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my flank.

lines.zh: 我被挤得往边上让了一点。
lines.en: I yielded a little to the side.
Too close. Back off.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴擦过你的肩膀。
lines.en: My tail brushed your shoulder.
Your scent is on me now.
A dull thud. Thick soil.

lines.zh: 你站在我前面，挡住路了。
lines.en: You're in my way.

lines.zh: 我这种，只从一颗牙知道。
lines.en: My kind is known from one tooth.

lines.zh: 没人知道我怎么办这些事。
lines.en: No one knows how I'd do this.
Stay back. My teeth are too long.
None of this matters.
I only care about the next meal.
I lower my head. Don't move.
This big, I'd crush you.
This body is too heavy.
Back away. That's best.
Don't touch my mouth. Teeth too long.
I bite. My teeth go through it.
Too small to hold.
I pin it with a forelimb.
A smell on the ground. I sniff.
I carry it a few steps.
Not meat. Spat out.
Yours. I snapped it up.
Weightless in my mouth.
This tooth of mine is longer than your knife.
It's stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 你站的那块地，我记住了。
lines.en: The ground you stand on — noted.
This head of mine is up.
The wind brought you.
One shadow that long. Only you.
I shift my weight onto my hind legs.
You've moved. I know where.

lines.zh: 你踩碎枯枝，我就转头了。
lines.en: You snapped a dead branch; I turned.
Nothing else ahead.

lines.zh: 我张开了嘴，牙全露出来。
lines.en: Mouth open. Every tooth showing.
You heard my breathing.
I know this ground. You don't.
I'm starting to walk.

lines.zh: 我这么重，走过来就是压力。
lines.en: Weight this heavy is pressure by itself.
You retreat. The pits follow.
My teeth are too long to close.
No need to speed up at this range.
Behind a tree. The tree's too thin.
My tail sweeps. Grass goes down.
Your breathing is uneven.
Head down. Teeth on you.
Don't count on outrunning me.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要用整个身体。
lines.en: I'll use my whole body for this.
Every step of mine leaves a shallow pit.

lines.zh: 你转身之前，我已经到了。
lines.en: Before you turn, I'm there.
Two steps left. There.

lines.zh: 一口咬下去，牙全扎进去。
lines.en: One bite. Every tooth in.
One shake of my head lifts you.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你扫开好几步。
lines.en: That swept you several steps away.
Teeth too long. Poor grip.
All I have is one fossil tooth.
You're pressed into the soil.
I hold you still.
I haven't used that in years.
My teeth are in your shield. Not letting go.
Half a step back. Mouth opens again.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被牙刮了一道。
lines.en: A tooth furrowed your armor.
My tail cracked your side.

lines.zh: 我从干裂的地里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of cracked earth.

lines.zh: 这地方没有水，但够我活。
lines.en: No water. Enough to live on.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，尘都起来了。
lines.en: Dust rose when I landed.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，先尝了尝空气。
lines.en: Mouth open. First taste of the air.
I've stood a long time on dry ground.
My shadow is long. Thin too.
Wind whistles between my teeth.
This spot. Chosen.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，从远处过来。
lines.en: Step by step, from far off.
Hear the ground drumming?

lines.zh: 我这种动物，很少有人见。
lines.en: Few people have seen my kind.
I raise my head. Directions noted.
The soil collapsed under my feet.

lines.zh: 我从干河床的雾里立起来。
lines.en: I rise from the mist of the dry riverbed.

lines.zh: 火烧过来，我往旱地深处走。
lines.en: Fire. I head deeper into the dry land.
I fell. My teeth clashed together.

lines.zh: 水太深，我这种长腿也没用。
lines.en: Deep water. Even legs like mine can't help.
The blast knocked my whole length down.
Something stuck between my teeth.
That light softened my bones.

lines.zh: 旱地空了，我饿得站不住。
lines.en: Dry land's empty. Can't stand with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，牙都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning on my back. Even my teeth shook.

lines.zh: 往下掉，我这么长也没用。
lines.en: Falling. Being this long doesn't help.
